title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: This dataset contains ictal and interictal stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 8 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital. It provides the example data for the BrainQuake toolbox, with a 71-second seizure clip per patient for epileptogenicity index analysis and interictal segments of up to about 2 hours for high-frequency event detection. The recordings are reorganised into iEEG-BIDS without signal processing. MRI and CT volumes are not redistributed.
methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were sampled at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Pre-implant MRI and post-implant CT were acquired for electrode localisation. Ictal EDF files are byte-identical to the source release. Interictal EDF+D files had only the patient name in the first annotation overwritten.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key R&D Program of China
